name: Battle of Warsong Gulch
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
The battle in Warsong Gulch against the Silverwing Sentinels is of great importance. Under the guise of protecting a forest that doesn't belong to them, the Alliance seeks to deny the Horde one of our largest sources for lumber.

Do not let this happen, adventurer! Come back to me with proof of serving the Horde in a worthy manner!
narrative.objectives: Bring 3 Warsong Marks of Honor to a Horde Warbringer outside the battlegrounds.
narrative.offerRewardText: Excellent! You've shown your worth by defending our operations in Warsong Gulch! May word of your honor spread far and wide across our lands.
